shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final background artwork for the playable browser space game Space Dodger 3D: Starfall Odyssey, not a mockup. Generate ONE finished 2048x1152 wide landscape cinematic space matte painting. AAA science-fiction game environment quality, detailed luminous gases, astronomical depth, rich colour and layered star fields. The central 55 percent must contain beautiful visible cloud detail for portrait-phone cropping. Leave the lower central flight area reasonably uncluttered for separately rendered spaceships, hazards and HUD. This is the distant environment behind real 3D gameplay. Artwork fills every edge with space, no frame or square inset, no ground or horizon, no cockpit, no foreground ships or large foreground asteroids, no UI, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no multiple panels. Keep black/navy space balanced with visibly luminous colourful clouds; do not make it empty or nearly black. No huge blown-out white areas. Sector scene:

assets.name: Launch Corridor
assets.scene_prompt: Earth orbit at first light: a huge blue atmospheric crescent in the upper left, turquoise aurora sweeping across the central starfield, warm sunrise behind a remote moon, rich blue interstellar dust.

assets.name: Meteor Scar
assets.scene_prompt: An ancient asteroid belt in amber and burnt copper: a broken rocky moon far away above centre-right, layered fine golden dust lanes running diagonally across indigo space, distant rubble silhouettes only, spectacular orange illuminated clouds.

assets.name: Nebula Gate
assets.scene_prompt: A violet emission nebula with an enormous softly glowing circular void in its clouds, lavender filaments, bright electric blue gas pillars and magenta star forming knots, inviting luminous route through its centre.

assets.name: Drone Forge
assets.scene_prompt: An artificial orbital forge far in the distance: immense dark segmented factory ring barely silhouetted against hot magenta-red nebulae, cool blue stars, geometric industrial lights confined to the distant upper skyline.

assets.name: Comet Rapids
assets.scene_prompt: A dazzling ice comet corridor: sweeping cyan-white comet tails far in the distance, crystalline blue dust ribbons, cold teal nebulae and tiny silver stars, a pale distant frozen moon near the upper edge.

assets.name: Pirate Signal
assets.scene_prompt: Remote outer relay region with smoky orange and vermilion nebula clouds, sparse tiny red signal beacons on very distant orbital structures, deep cobalt shadows, old lonely frontier space.

assets.name: Crystal Rift
assets.scene_prompt: An emerald and turquoise gravitational rift: a fractured distant crystal moon above, luminous green mist torn into elegant curling ribbons around a dark centre, glittering crystalline star dust and violet faraway stars.

assets.name: Mothership Shadow
assets.scene_prompt: Dark armada territory: the tiny distant silhouettes of a huge carrier and fleet in upper space, crimson nebula fire glowing behind them, charcoal navy darkness with red-burgundy dust rivers and cold starlight. Menacing yet richly visible.

assets.name: Solar Furnace
assets.scene_prompt: At the edge of a giant orange star: its curved corona and detailed solar prominences occupy the upper left quadrant, gold plasma arches reaching across maroon space, deep blue-black regions elsewhere; dramatic controlled light with no white washout.

assets.name: Black Star Run
assets.scene_prompt: A mysterious black-star void: an eclipsed dark sphere above the centre surrounded by a purple gravitational lensing halo, flowing indigo and blue nebula currents, tiny icy star clusters and luminous violet tendrils.

assets.name: Starfall Siege
assets.scene_prompt: Enemy capital far away: the distant curved rim of a dark industrial planet at the top, scarlet city lights and angular orbital bastion silhouettes in the far upper distance, fuchsia and electric violet nebulae across the centre.

assets.name: Odyssey Finale
assets.scene_prompt: The brilliant Starfall Core: a radiant distant cyan-white star seen through majestic layered blue and turquoise nebula curtains, a fractured planetary ring tracing an elegant arc in the far distance, triumphant scale and rich royal blue space.

assets.name: Echoes of Asterion
assets.scene_prompt: Lost survey fleet graveyard far away in space: tiny ancient shipwreck silhouettes drifting near a fragmented green-grey moon, haunting emerald mist and teal gas pillars, distant gold star clusters, beautiful melancholy deep space.

assets.name: Ion Tempest
assets.scene_prompt: A spectacular sapphire ion storm in deep space: electric-blue forks illuminating enormous cobalt and violet gas clouds, bright turquoise charged filaments around dark navy pockets, a distant moon half veiled by storm. Clearly visible dramatic atmosphere.

assets.name: Relay Breaker
assets.scene_prompt: The Silent Array: thin distant communication dishes and lattice relay silhouettes on the edge of a red moon high in frame, crimson and rose nebula filaments through a star-filled dark blue sky, technological mystery.

assets.name: Ark of the Dawn
assets.scene_prompt: A hopeful refugee passage: warm golden dawn star shining through peach and copper interstellar clouds, turquoise star dust sweeping past a faraway habitable planet near the top, luminous welcoming cosmic vista.

assets.name: Singularity Crossing
assets.scene_prompt: A black hole crossing: an elegant thin accretion ring of purple and gold light around a dark singularity high in the image, gravitationally curved blue star bands and lavender nebula clouds, awe-inspiring event-horizon landscape without a bright white centre.

assets.name: Heart of Starfall
assets.scene_prompt: The Sovereign Citadel far away, a majestic dark angular fortress silhouette small in the upper centre, surrounded by a vast bright cyan and crimson nebula vortex, blue starlight and ruby reactor-like distant glows, epic climactic space panorama.
